profile: bounded explicit discrete constant-acceleration trajectory and independent closed-form differential numerical checks; no arbitrary physics/HPC claim

trials.intent: Each explicit step advances position by the old velocity, then adds acceleration to velocity, and appends the new position to the trajectory.
The closed-form position must match explicit integration where position is advanced with old velocity before acceleration changes that velocity.
The final velocity after a given number of constant-acceleration discrete steps must match the explicit step integrator, including zero steps.
